description: This file defines models, interfaces, and classes related to the dashboard page in the Thingsboard UI, including dashboard context, layout, widget management, and interaction methods.

classes.name: LayoutWidgetsArray
classes.description: A class managing an array of widget IDs and providing iterable access to widget objects within a dashboard context.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of widget IDs stored.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Indicates whether the widget IDs are still loading.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the widget list is loaded and empty.

methods.name: setWidgetIds
methods.description: Sets the widget IDs array and marks as loaded.

methods.name: addWidgetId
methods.description: Adds a widget ID to the list.

methods.name: removeWidgetId
methods.description: Removes a widget ID from the list, returns true if successful.

methods.name: [Symbol.iterator]
methods.description: Provides an iterator over Widget objects based on stored widget IDs.

methods.name: widgetByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a widget by its index in the widget ID list.

methods.name: widgetById
methods.description: Retrieves a widget object by its widget ID.
